nom: HERBIVORE BLUE TANSY Resurfacing Clarity Mask

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the mask balances oiliness and reduces acne without over-drying, and several say it works well despite them expecting it to be too harsh.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report no tightness or over-drying after use, unlike other clay masks that leave their skin feeling like a 'crusty desert'.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, some leaning oily, report clearer, less blemished skin and smaller-looking pores within weeks.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report the mask exfoliates gently without irritating their barrier, though a few say they were initially apprehensive about trying it.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s or identifying as having 'mature' or 'senior' skin report brighter, more even, hydrated skin and reduced fine-line visibility.
segments.normal: A few reviewers without oily or blemish-prone skin still report softness and glow after use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 40s report a more even skin tone, brightness, and less reliance on full-coverage makeup; one mature reviewer highlights hydration and smoothness as the main gains.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe the mask as non-drying and even hydrating afterward, including one with dry skin who reports zero tightness, though one reviewer notes results can vary by how long the mask is left on.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness, including one whose hormonal-acne redness disappeared within two days and another whose rosacea 'disappeared in one use'; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Sensitive-skin reviewers report the mask exfoliates without disrupting or irritating the skin barrier, calling it gentler than typical acids or clay masks.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading of hyperpigmentation and post-acne dark spots after repeated use over one to several weeks.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, including many with acne-prone or hormonal-acne skin, report fewer breakouts, faster healing of active blemishes, and smoother skin; one reviewer notes occasional pimples still occur but breakouts are less frequent, and one mentions purging ('my skin will be popping the next day') as an initial reaction.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the mask helps balance oil production and reduce shine without stripping the skin.

extraits.texte: I've struggled with acne most of my life, this brand has absolutely saved me. But this mask specifically is a complete and utter game changer. After the acne cleared I was still struggling with texture and blackheads pretty badly. I use this mask up to twice a week and have been doing that for about 3 months now. The difference is insane. My texture is so much better, skin is smooth and has glow (not oily) and the blackheads are way less visible! I finally get compliments on my skin! I don't think I have the most sensitive skin, but I definitely have acne prone and this never once made me breakout or anything negative. I'd definitely recommend it to other, and have!

I have blemish prone, combination skin. When I started using it, my face was covered in hormonal acne (~12 distinct bumps) along my jaw and cheeks. After using it the first night, I noticed existing acne was noticeably less red and no new acne formed. Every night I used it, my acne became less and less noticeable - by the 4th use, my face was clear for the first time in years!! I now continue to use it as directed (2-3 times a week) and my skin is stays blemish free 95% of the time (an improvement from 0% of the time). I hadn't changed anything else in my skin routine during this time, so I know this mask is the reason for my clearer, smoother skin. It's become the most essential skin product I own.

I have pretty sensitive skin that leans towards the dry side, so a lot of the clay based masks just leave my face looking like a crusty desert replete with acne. This is probably my fifth or sixth jar of the Blue Tansy mask and honestly it's become such a holy grail for me. I love the smell and my skin looks and feels so much better after I use it. I usually don't spend more than $15 per skincare/makeup product, but I'll always make an exception for this mask. It lasts for so long and the results are definitely worth it to me!

extraits.titre: I didn't know I could have skin like this!
extraits.texte: This mask was purchased on a whim, but it has absolutely changed the entire surface of my skin! My pores are smaller and cleaner. My skin is incredibly smooth and clear. I have rosacea with occasional acne, and since I've been using this mask, it's finally gotten under control! I don't even want to wear foundation anymore. HIGHLY recommend!

This is one of VERY few products I purchase on repeat. My sensitive skin loves it. It helps gently exfoliate without irritating my skin barrier (like almost all other products). I'm 44 with some redness and breakouts, this has become a staple in my routine. 3 times per week for 20 mins (work up to that!) Highly recommend giving it a try.

Absolutely love this product! I've been struggling with skin problems for years. I have really oily skin which is a blessing and a curse because no wrinkles but acne. I'm just glad I FINALLY found something to even out my skin.

extraits.titre: Why aren't the directions on the product?
extraits.texte: I love the product itself; I've been using for two months and whenever I forget to use it for a bit, I can absolutely tell. I can never remember how long any given mask is supposed to stay on or whether it is a thick or thin layer mask and it drives me mad that all herbivore products, including full size, do not have directions on them.
